requirement_review.user_intent: Norven asked Cap to clear the previous probe pollution and complete the missing runtime/project directory isolation logic, including a broader re-scan of old RedCap runtime artifact and self-code separation designs.
requirement_review.target_reality: External managed projects use their own <project_workspace>/.redcap/ directory for RedCap runtime artifacts; RedCap's repository remains implementation code and self-development evidence only; user-private identity remains outside both.
non_goals: Do not implement the full complete-revival E2E harness in this task.
Do not claim RedCap complete revival is terminally complete.
Do not copy old RedCap's whole runtime state shell stack wholesale.
Do not move user-private identity or host credentials into project .redcap.
Do not bulk-read the old RedCap repository.

technical_review.rollback_plan: Revert changes to runtime/core/runtime_boundary.py, runtime/core/status_surface.py, runtime/bin/redcap help text, runtime boundary docs, and E2E acceptance design updates; restore stale lane-review files only if they are needed as evidence.

prompt_context.source_prompt_excerpt: 1. 先确认当前工作的污染是否完全清楚了，不会影响后续redcap的复活计划工作 2. 继续补充完善还没修复好的逻辑，保证目录和运行时产物是隔离的。并且，需要举一反三，将所有旧redcap中关于运行时产物、自身逻辑代码相关联的逻辑和优秀设计再扫描和理解一边，然后力求此次复活的完整性

task_body.requested_outcome: Repair RedCap project-runtime isolation so external managed project artifacts live under the project-level .redcap directory while RedCap code, self-development evidence, and user-private state remain separated.
acceptance_criteria: Previous Codex CLI probe pollution is classified and no live probe process remains.
External project state_root and evidence_root default under project_runtime_root, not under RedCap runtime_root.
Boundary validation rejects external runtime artifacts outside project_runtime_root unless the task is self-development.
Self-development mode continues to allow RedCap's own repository as project_workspace.
Status output exposes project_runtime_root so humans can see where runtime artifacts live.
The complete-revival E2E design requires a managed project .redcap runtime directory.
Stale unfinished lane-review contract files are removed or folded into this task's evidence.

findings: 外部项目运行产物不再进入共享哈希目录作为默认路径，而是收束到项目自己的 .redcap；RedCap 自研例外只由解析后路径相等触发。
棱镜两方 concern 均已采纳，并通过 prism-resolution 检查；旧证据只暴露 legacy_external_evidence_root，不自动迁移。
完整复活 E2E 设计已要求外部沙盒项目拥有 .redcap 项目运行目录，并新增运行产物未收束到 .redcap 的负向探针。

completion_claim.scope: 本次项目运行目录隔离修复；不声明 RedCap 完整复活终局完成
